content.text: Dan traces Althea from New York to Donovan’s saloon in Brooklyn, disguising himself as an Italian street musician and following Hartley via ferry and streetcar. With a newsboy’s help, he finds Althea, escapes Donovan’s cellar, and brings her back to his mother. Harriet Vernon arrives at the Fifth Avenue Hotel, rejects Hartley’s demands, and learns Dan foiled him. Hartley is arrested in New York for forged railway certificates. Harriet adopts Dan and reunites the family in a Madison Avenue home. Years later, dying ex-bookkeeper Robert Hunting (Davis) summons Dan to the St. Nicholas Hotel, confesses robbing his father, and restores $50,000. Dan prospers; Hartley dies in prison.
